---
title: "Round numbers turn into 1e+05 in text"
ref: NUM-10
categories: [Numbers]
impact: silencieux
extrait: 'paste0("id_", 100000)'
reponse: '"id_1e+05"'
attendu: "`\"id_100000\"`"
versions: "All"
source: "General R knowledge"
---

::: {.piege}
```{r}
as.character(100000)
paste0("id_", c(99999, 100000, 100001))
```
:::

## Why

To convert a double to text, R picks the shortest form. `100000` takes 6 characters, `1e+05` takes 5: scientific notation wins. `100001` has no shorter form and stays as is.

Only "round" numbers are affected, which makes the pitfall rare and therefore hard to spot. Identifiers, codes or file names built with `paste0()` break a join for a handful of rows only.

## The fix

Format the number explicitly before pasting it.

::: {.piege}
```{r}
paste0("id_", format(c(99999, 100000, 100001), scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE))
sprintf("id_%.0f", c(99999, 100000, 100001))
```
:::
